tier1.text: The supraspinatus helps abduct the arm, raising the arm out to the side, away from the body. The supraspinatus runs from the scapula, or shoulder blade, to the humerus, or arm bone. The muscle is named for its place above a ridge called the spine of the scapula. The supraspinatus is one of four rotator cuff muscles, whose tendons circle and support the shoulder.

quotes.quote: These muscles (supraspinatus, infraspinatus, teres minor, and subscapularis) arise from the scapula and attach to the greater or lesser tubercles of the humerus.

quotes.quote: The scapula (shoulder blade) lies on the posterior aspect of the shoulder. It is supported by the clavicle and articulates with the humerus (arm bone) to form the shoulder joint.

quotes.quote: rotator cuff: (also, musculotendinous cuff) the circle of tendons around the shoulder joint
